review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY Reporting to the Lead HR Officer (Trainee), the HR Officer plays a key role in ensuring the smooth execution of HR operations and maintaining a positive employee experience at SUMO Services Corporation. This role oversees the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding, contract and performance management, and disciplinary administration to payroll coordination and offboarding, while ensuring compliance with company policies and government regulations.   Beyond daily HR operations, the HR Officer also manages employee records, logistics, and government-related tasks, and provides support in implementing policies and engagement initiatives. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and people-focused, capable of balancing administrative precision with a strong understanding of HR best practices to help strengthen SUMO's culture of compliance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.   SCOPE AND RESPONSIBILITIES Employee Lifecycle Management Prepare, draft, and manage all employee and contractor contracts in coordination with relevant teams, ensuring timely updates, renewals, addendums, and variations. Lead onboarding and orientation for new employees, ensuring compliance, system setup, and proper turnover to supervisors. Oversee the offboarding process, including required documents, exit interviews, and turnover of responsibilities before departure. Support the end-to-end performance review process, including scheduling, documentation, and maintenance of records. Investigate grievances, prepare documentation, and coordinate disciplinary meetings and issuances in line with company policy.   Payroll & Statutory Compliance Prepare payroll, including monitoring attendance and leave balances and handling payroll adjustments and related concerns. Process government-mandated statutory contributions and remittances with SSS, HDMF, and PHIC, including 13th month pay and annualization. Compute and process final pay for resigned or terminated employees, and file SSS maternity and other statutory benefit claims as needed. Liaison & Logistics Coordinate government-mandated compliance requirements with DOLE and other agencies, as well as document notarization and other external transactions with the company's legal partners. Manage procurement and delivery of company equipment, HMO cards, and other employee-related items, including the sending and delivery of legal and official documents to employees and other parties involved.   HR Operations & Administration Maintain employee files and records, ensuring document completeness, proper access, and accurate record-keeping, while addressing employee inquiries and disseminating important company updates through the appropriate channels. Provide general administrative support to employees, handling ad hoc administrative requests, petty cash and reimbursement processing, and bank reconciliation support as needed. Support HR projects and tasks delegated by the Lead HR Officer (Trainee) or management, meeting agreed timelines.   MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Education & Experience Preferably with a bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management or Psychology, or a related field. At least 2–3 years of experience in HR, contracts administration, and/or general administrative roles.   Technical Expertise & Compliance Working knowledge of employment contracts, labor laws, and the end-to-end employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding. Experience with payroll, timekeeping, and leave management systems (Sprout HR experience required). Proficient in Google, Microsoft, or Zoho tools (Word, Excel, Slides).   Interpersonal Skills & Judgment Skilled in handling employee relations matters, including performance and discipline management, with strong communication and interpersonal skills to navigate these situations effectively. Strong organizational skills with close attention to detail and accuracy in document preparation, and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion. IMPORTANT: This is a hybrid work arrangement, with onsite reporting required at least twice a month or as needed for business operations. Subject to change once a physical office is secured in Metro Manila (e.g., once a week). Recruitment Process: Written Examination (Onsite) — As the initial screening stage, candidates will complete a written assessment covering: Contract Drafting and Payroll. Interview with Lead HR Officer (Trainee) (Onsite, same day as the written examination) Interview with HR Manager (Onsite, same day as the written examination)

review_candidates.description: If you are energised by relationship-led influence, leading change, and applying AI-enabled approaches to financial management, this role offers the opportunity to coach finance leaders, build scalable practices, and help a group of businesses deliver strong consolidated financial results. What is unique about us? Omegro is an international buy-and-grow acquirer of software companies looking for a permanent and safe home to continue their legacy and provide long-term sustainable growth for their people, their businesses, and their stakeholders. As a people-first organisation, we believe in liberating the potential in our businesses and our people. We foster a culture of collaboration, learning, curiosity and best-practice sharing, underpinned by our values of humble, hungry and smart. You’ll enjoy being part of our team if you find joy in building trusted relationships, creating clarity in growth and ambiguous environments, taking an AI-first approach to improving ways of working, and helping leaders and teams grow through change. Where you’ll make an impact This is a strategic, coaching and senior advisory role within a publicly listed portfolio of businesses. As the finance leader for a group of companies, you will be accountable for the consolidated financial performance of the group while enabling local Finance Managers to be successful, commercially confident and increasingly autonomous. As we acquire, integrate and grow businesses, this role is suited to individuals who enjoy partnering with Finance Managers, General Managers, CEOs and wider leadership teams to translate strategy into practical plans, scalable frameworks and high-impact initiatives that support financial performance, disciplined execution and successful acquisitions. The work requires resilience, commercial judgement, strong relationship-building, an AI-enabled mindset, and the ability to bring structure, momentum and care to complex, changing environments. You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution while connecting with the wider Omegro team globally, including opportunities for learning, development and travel. Who will I report to? Chief Financial Officer What will you bring? You’ll thrive here if you have operated as a senior finance leader, can build trust quickly across diverse business leadership teams, enjoy turning complexity into clear, practical action, and bring strong judgement through data-led decision making and strategic business partnering. You are motivated by coaching others to succeed, creating accountability through clear communication, and helping Finance Managers build the capability, confidence and discipline needed to support high-performing businesses. Key attributes: Have tertiary qualifications in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business or a related discipline, with CPA, CA, CMA or equivalent professional accreditation highly regarded. Have experience (minimum of 10 years) in a senior Finance role, ideally within a software, technology or acquisitive environment. Have deep financial leadership experience in North America, with global exposure across regions such as Asia Pacific or other international markets advantageous. Be motivated by and live our values, humble, hungry and smart. Build trusted and inclusive relationships, facilitate meaningful conversations, lead forums, share best practice and create alignment across autonomous businesses. Lead by example in AI first process change management building scalable application and improved capacity over time Coach and develop business-based Finance Managers to strengthen commercial insight, reporting cadence, forecasting quality, financial controls and confidence in partnering with their local leadership teams. Support the coaching of business leaders to achieve agreed metrics and results and drive actions plans Operate with self-motivation, grit, maturity, resilience and flexibility across time zones, priorities and diverse stakeholder groups. Build financial leadership capability through coaching, succession planning, talent management, career planning, performance enablement and retention strategies. Demonstrated M&A experience, including due diligence and integration activities. Demonstrated experience developing and delivering finance strategy, budgets, goals and financial targets. Take ownership of group-level financial performance, including consolidated results, forecasting discipline, reporting quality, financial governance and the timely identification of risks, opportunities and corrective actions. Demonstrated experience with accounting, fiduciary, risk and statutory compliance requirements. The role can be performed flexibly and remotely from the North America, so you’ll need to be comfortable building relationships intentionally, staying connected across locations and creating momentum without relying on proximity. Domestic and international travel will be required, along with flexibility to connect with colleagues across North America, APAC and Europe regions. To Apply If you are excited by the opportunity to build trusted relationships, create clarity through change and help shape growth practices and acquisitions across a people-first portfolio of businesses, we’d love to hear from you. We welcome applicants with a wide range of experiences and perspectives. Total compensation circa $200K. We hire based on qualifications and job-related criteria and do not discriminate on legally protected grounds. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process upon request. Please submit a Resume highlighting your suitability to the above-mentioned key attributes. Applications close COB 25 October.

review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer & Creative Content Executive to join Fits Holidays, the leisure travel division of FitsAir. The ideal candidate will create engaging visual content, digital creatives, and marketing materials that showcase travel destinations, holiday packages, and promotional campaigns while maintaining brand consistency across all platforms. This role offers an exciting opportunity to combine creativity and visual storytelling to inspire travellers and support the growth of our outbound travel business. Graphic Designer & Creative Content Executive 1. Brand & Visual Design Develop creative designs that are consistent with the company’s brand identity and visual standards. Create and maintain brand assets, templates, and design guidelines. Ensure consistency across all digital and offline marketing materials. 2. Social Media & Digital Content Design engaging graphics and visual content for social media platforms. Create content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, websites, email campaigns, and other digital channels. Adapt designs into different formats and sizes for various platforms. Work closely with the marketing team to develop creative concepts for social media campaigns. 3. Marketing & Campaign Materials Design promotional materials for travel campaigns, offers, destinations, packages, and seasonal promotions. Create brochures, flyers, presentations, advertisements, banners, and other marketing collateral. Develop creative concepts for new campaigns and promotional initiatives. 4. Travel & Destination Content Create visually appealing destination-focused content that reflects the Go Byond brand and travel experience. Develop creative layouts for destination campaigns, itineraries, travel packages, and trade materials. Ensure imagery, typography, layouts, and overall design communicate the desired destination and brand positioning. 5. Video & Motion Content Create basic motion graphics, animated posts, reels, and short-form video content where required. Edit and adapt existing video and visual assets for digital marketing purposes. 6. Collaboration & Creative Support Work closely with the marketing, sales, and management teams to understand campaign objectives and deliver appropriate creative materials. Translate briefs and ideas into strong visual concepts. Support the team with ad-hoc design requirements and time-sensitive marketing campaigns. 7. Design Management Maintain an organised library of design files, templates, images, and brand assets. Ensure all final artwork is prepared correctly for digital and print use. Manage multiple design projects and deadlines while maintaining quality and consistency. Stay updated on current design, social media, and digital content trends and bring fresh ideas to the brand. Qualifications & Experience Diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia Design, or a related field. 2–4 years of relevant graphic design experience, preferably in travel, hospitality, tourism, lifestyle, or a related industry. Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator. Experience with Canva and other digital design tools. Basic knowledge of video editing and motion graphics is an advantage. Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, branding, and visual storytelling. Good understanding of social media content requirements and digital advertising formats. Strong creative portfolio demonstrating a range of digital and marketing work. Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Strong attention to detail and a good eye for aesthetics. Personal Attributes Creative and able to bring fresh ideas to the brand. Proactive and able to work independently. Strong attention to detail. Flexible and able to work across different types of creative requirements. Good communication and collaboration skills. Able to work in a fast-paced environment and manage tight deadlines. Why Join Fits Holidays? Fits Holidays, the leisure travel division of FitsAir, offers the opportunity to be part of a growing travel brand backed by an established airline. Gain valuable industry exposure, contribute to exciting travel initiatives, and grow your career in a dynamic and expanding business. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply by sending their updated CV and creative portfolio to hello@fitsholidays.com. Kindly include relevant experience in graphic design, digital content creation, and marketing materials. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the selection process.

review_candidates.title: Event Management Specialist
review_candidates.description: About the Job At Headmaster HR , we are committed to connecting talented professionals with exciting career opportunities. We are currently looking for a skilled, creative, and results-oriented individual to join our client's team as an Executive – Event Management . If you have a passion for event planning, promotions, brand activations, and event operations, this is an excellent opportunity to showcase your expertise and advance your career in a dynamic environment. Job Description Plan, coordinate, and execute events, promotions, and activations, ensuring smooth delivery from initial setup through completion. Coordinate event technical requirements, including sound, lighting, staging, power, production setup, and related infrastructure, while ensuring compliance with safety standards. Manage event logistics, vendor coordination, installation schedules, dismantling, and operational requirements to ensure events are delivered on time and according to specifications. Coordinate signage and branding requirements, including promotional signage, event branding, directional signage, and physical branding installations. Prepare and maintain operational documentation, including floor layouts, setup plans, drawings, vendor briefs, quotations, and comparative summaries. Coordinate purchase approvals and invoice submissions with the Finance team. Liaise with event suppliers, production vendors, signage suppliers, and other external service providers to ensure seamless event execution. Candidate Requirements A minimum of four years of hands-on experience in events, promotions, activations, or a related field, preferably in retail, hospitality, entertainment, exhibitions, agencies, or other high-activity environments. Good practical knowledge of event production, sound, lighting, staging, event logistics, and safety requirements. Experience working with event suppliers, production vendors, signage suppliers, and external service providers. Strong planning, coordination, and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple operational requirements simultaneously. Good verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to prepare briefs, maintain documentation, and coordinate effectively with internal teams and external partners. Willingness to work weekends, public holidays, and extended hours when required for events and installations. What We Offer An opportunity to work in a dynamic environment focused on events, promotions, and customer experiences. The opportunity to contribute your expertise while developing your professional career in event management. How to Apply Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their updated CV through Headmaster HR using the application details provided. Take the next step in your event management career with this exciting opportunity! #Hiring #HeadmasterHR #EventManagement #EventPlanning #EventExecutive #BrandActivations #Promotions #SriLankaJobs #CareerOpportunities #EventPlanner #EventExecutive #PR #PersonalRelations #Marketing #Coordinator

review_candidates.title: European Sales Representative
review_candidates.description: About Us & The Role Fudar Alloy Materials Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in the R&D and manufacturing of electrical contact materials (silver contacts). Our products are widely used in relays, switches, circuit breakers, connectors, and other low-voltage electrical devices. To further expand our presence in the European market, we are looking for 1–2 talented professionals to join us. This is a ground-floor, start-from-scratch opportunity. You will serve as our core sales force in Europe, responsible for developing new clients, maintaining strategic customer relationships, and achieving sales targets. If you have experience serving overseas electrical giants and are eager to make an impact on a high-growth platform, we look forward to hearing from you. Territory Coverage: Poland, Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, and surrounding countries. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute sales strategies for the assigned region; achieve regional sales targets Focus on winning strategic accounts: Schneider Electric, ABB, Siemens, Eaton – driving the entire process from lead generation to order closure Explore new clients in low-voltage electrical, automotive components, new energy (energy storage/PV/charging piles), data centers, and smart grid sectors Lead contract negotiations, order execution, and accounts receivable management Act as the bridge between China HQ (R&D & Production) and European clients to ensure successful delivery Requirements Bachelor's degree or above Approximately 3 years of B2B industrial sales experience (any industry) Based in Poland (this is a Poland-based, remote role covering Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, and neighboring markets) Fluent in English and Polish，t hose who are good at other small languages get extra points. Comfortable with frequent travel and able to drive projects independently Preferred Qualifications: Background in electrical contact materials / precious metal alloys, e.g., DODUCO, Heraeus, Materion, Umicore, Tanaka, Metalor, etc. Background in solder / brazing materials, e.g., Almit, Senju, Indium, Kester, AIM, Harris Products, etc. Background in low-voltage components / connectors, e.g., TE Connectivity, Amphenol, Phoenix Contact, Wieland, KME, etc. Background in relays / switches / circuit breakers, e.g., Omron, Fuji Electric, Panasonic, Hongfa, Zhengtai, etc. Direct experience serving overseas electrical or automotive giants, e.g., Schneider Electric, ABB, Siemens, Eaton, Bosch, Continental, ZF Friedrichshafen, etc. Sales experience in metals / materials industry, e.g., non-ferrous metals, precious metals, alloy materials, electrical materials, etc. Existing customer relationships in Europe, particularly in low-voltage electrical, new energy, or automotive components sectors Compensation & Benefits Annual Package: €35,000 – €53,000 High Commission (uncapped), with additional bonuses for winning strategic accounts Work Mode: Remote, work from home with flexible hours Location Poland (remote, with travel within the covered region)

review_candidates.title: Director, Construction, APAC
review_candidates.description: Requirements Description & Requirements who we are lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people. About This Team The Store Development team has a unique opportunity to shape lululemon’s physical presence across our Asia-Pacific markets. From identifying new store opportunities and partnering on real estate strategy, to delivering new stores, relocations, renovations, minor works, and facilities programs across our existing portfolio, we help bring the brand to life in the communities we serve. We work closely with regional and local teams, design partners, and external stakeholders to create exceptional retail environments that elevate the guest and educator experience. We’re a passionate, collaborative team that thrives on solving complex challenges, building strong partnerships, and bringing bold ideas to life. Committed to continuous improvement and best-in-class execution, we work at the intersection of real estate, design, construction, and facilities to support the full lifecycle of our stores and lululemon’s growth across the region. As a Director, Construction, APAC, you'll play a key role in turning these opportunities into reality, leading projects from concept through to store opening, optimizations, temporary/pop-up stores across our diverse Asia-Pacific markets. Core Responsibilities Lead a team responsible for executing all retail construction projects within APAC Region (New Store Openings Optimizations, Renovations, Temp Spaces, Pop-up build outs, etc.) Develop and implement new execution strategies, with a strategic focus on elevating quality and reducing costs to improve overall store economics Oversee the successful delivery of all projects on time and on budget while managing key project level milestones and metrics Oversee all major vendor relationships across the Construction categories (50+ vendors) including onboarding/offboarding vendors, establishing and maintaining service level agreements, and optimizing sourcing strategies Manage the timely execution of all repairs within established budgets and service level agreements. Define overarching budgets, monitor spending, and allocate resources based on strategic values across all project executions. Provide leadership to the team by managing performance, conducting regular pace checks, and offering constructive feedback to support their development Coach, mentor, and develop a team of skilled Construction Management professionals Collaborate with Retail Operations, Real Estate, Store Design, Procurement, and FP&A on new ways of working in the pursuit of operational excellence Play a key role in shaping strategic decisions for the area or team regarding capital and expense repairs/projects Establish collaborative partnerships with stakeholders throughout the organization to enhance communication and align objectives for successful outcomes. Utilize strong analytical skills to evaluate complex situations, analyze data, and provide informed recommendations for optimal solutions Qualifications 15+ years project management experience within a retail construction environment Vendor Management experience 10+ years of leading construction professionals, contractors, and teams True regional professional with projects experiences throughout major Asia cities as well as Australia & New Zealand Demonstrated experience in creating/managing a portfolio of projects from identification through to project close-out Expert in managing construction budgets, value engineering conversations and negotiating change orders Must be confident and concise in storytelling/presenting to executives that is supported with proficient financial acumen Strategic, people-focused leader who can develop and mentor teams and getting them to excel in their role Must have strong and proven work ethic, operating with utmost integrity Expert negotiation skills and tactics, who can articulate a compelling argument and drive negotiations to a favourable conclusion Must be able to collaborate and enroll others with a desire for constant self-improvement and learning; experience working in a matrixed organization with a variety of stakeholders Must be versatile and able to manage multiple projects in various stages at any one time in the life cycle of a project Practiced in store development processes, quantity survey, vendor management, client relations Regular travel may be required to markets and store sites pre-, during and post-construction must haves Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life. Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results. Communicates with honesty and kindness, and creates the space for others to do the same. Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously. Additional Notes Immigration support is potentially available for this role. Beyond The Paycheck (benefits & Perks) At lululemon, we care for and invest in the whole person – body, mind, spirit. Our total rewards program is designed to support you in achieving your goals and focus on the things you love. In addition to competitive base pay and a team-based bonus program, we also offer paid time off, generous employee discounts, fitness/yoga classes, parenthood top up program and personal and professional development programs. Note: availability of these benefits and perks may be subject to your location & employment type and may have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these benefits and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice. work arrangement In-person collaboration and/or office-based work is necessary or important for the role.
